title: The Doors of Durin
description: The Seven are finished. At the West-gate of Khazad-dûm Celebrimbor and the Dwarf-smith Narvi unveil doors inlaid with ithildin, a token of friendship between the two realms.

title: The king's ring
description: Wearing his ring, Durin III sees through the stone and knows exactly where to cut new sun-shafts. Light returns — and with it a hunger for gold. Singing to the rock, Disa finds a deep hall and hears something waiting beneath it.

title: Rings for Men
description: Annatar wants nine rings for Men; Celebrimbor refuses. When Durin warns that the Seven are changing his father, Annatar lays the blame on Celebrimbor's lie to the High King, and guilt drives the smith back to the forge.

title: Blood at the shrine
description: King Pharazôn strips the Faithful of their ranks and sends Kemen to tear down their oldest shrine. Kemen provokes a brawl and runs Valandil through from behind; Elendil is arrested for starting a riot.

title: Elrond's warning
description: Elrond reaches Lindon with Nenya and the news that Adar is marching on Eregion. Gil-galad will not spend his army on rescuing Galadriel while Sauron is the greater danger.

title: Adar's prisoner
description: Adar's host makes camp before Ost-in-Edhil with Galadriel in chains. He does not want her dead: he wants to talk.
